[SWS_TS_00057]
⌈
The TBR shall correct absolute time offsets between the
Global Time Base and the local instance of the Time Base (abs(TG - TLSync)), which are
smaller than the value given by ’OffsetCorrectionJumpThreshold’ by temporarily
applying an additional rate (roc) to rrc. This rate shall be used for the duration defined
by parameter ’OffsetCorrectionAdaptionInterval’. roc is calculated according
to the following formula:
roc = (TG - TLSync) / (TCorrInt) + 1
- TCorrInt = OffsetCorrectionAdaptionInterval
- TLSync = Value of the local instance of the Time Base before the new value of the
Global Time is applied
- TG = Received value of the Global Time
⌋
